deviations: User-authorized Amendment Revision1 appended verbatim and committed before any RPE1 scientific result; only this task-file change is outside scientific allowed_paths.
Cloud-specific execution supersedes Mac folders, launchers and fixed resource split; existing .venv reused as authorized.

Exact full control-only PCA-30 provides nested 15/20/30 axes; no extra scaling or whitening. K562 control-fitted PCA parameters and H caches from accepted S18 reused without refitting; no perturbed coordinates loaded from those caches until saved predictor barrier.
S18 energy test uses 2000 random controls, as specified by the referenced recipe; every centroid displacement uses ALL controls, not that test-reference subset.
All eligible targets are retained in per-target tables; report-only all-target comparisons use every significant analyzed target without the strong restriction.
The supplied protected tests have no xfail annotations; all 48 pass unchanged.
Fewer than 8 strong RPE1 T targets: confirmation stopped under the fixed rule; inferential confirmation statistics and gate pass fields are null, no threshold or group changed.

Initial delivery-only ZIP check failed after reusing ZipInfo objects in the open writer. The closed/reopened archive passed CRC and report-byte checks; final packaging now uses fresh entries and validates after closing. The failed checkpoint is retained. No scientific fit, selection, statistic, predictor or original input changed or was rerun.
observations: Original RPE1 size, supplied MD5 and planner-recorded SHA-256 match; original K562 SHA-256 unchanged.
Group symbols were resolved from raw obs metadata before expression/alignment; every learned predictor used controls only.
RPE1: 11485 controls of 247914 cells x 8749 genes; median control library 11720.
RPE1: 467/783 eligible targets significant; 94 strong, including T=4, M=9.
RPE1 PCA-20: 2297 edge controls, 575 soft edges; no-positive-eigenvalue fallback 0/2297 edges (0 selected soft edges).
RPE1 PCA-15: 2297 edge controls, 575 soft edges; no-positive-eigenvalue fallback 0/2297 edges (0 selected soft edges).
RPE1 PCA-30: 2297 edge controls, 575 soft edges; no-positive-eigenvalue fallback 0/2297 edges (0 selected soft edges).
K562: 10691 controls of 310385 cells x 8563 genes; median control library 13714.
K562: 865/1299 eligible targets significant; 173 strong, including T=27, M=21.
K562 PCA-20: 2139 edge controls, 535 soft edges; no-positive-eigenvalue fallback 0/2139 edges (0 selected soft edges).
K562 PCA-15: 2139 edge controls, 535 soft edges; no-positive-eigenvalue fallback 0/2139 edges (0 selected soft edges).
K562 PCA-30: 2139 edge controls, 535 soft edges; no-positive-eigenvalue fallback 0/2139 edges (0 selected soft edges).
RPE1 underpowered: confirmation stopped. K562 and all dimension/K/population variants are report-only and cannot rescue or confirm the primary outcome.
The four strong RPE1 T symbols are GTF2E2, INTS8, MED19, POLR2I. No gene was added to obtain the minimum group size.

K562 primary report-only median A_J(T)=0.511628, A_J(M)=0.863277, null95=0.735151. M has the higher median, opposite to the fixed T>M direction. Paired A_J>A_C among T has p=1.104176e-05; this does not make the three-part observation confirmed.
suggestions: A separately approved independent confirmation would need adequate representation of the fixed T group (at least 8 strong targets under the unchanged selection). Do not relax this screen's cutoff or expand the group post hoc to rescue the underpowered result. No further analysis was run.
